messages:
Maria G: Heads up — customer X is ramping 3x usage in us-west-2 starting tonight, and their job runs need 8xA100 allocation for steady throughput. Current reserved pool is exhausted. Can we temporarily bump them to a dedicated burst or preemptible burst while we sort a longer commit?

Raj P: Do we have spare capacity in other regions they can tolerate (latency might be worse)?

Maria G: Latency sensitivity is moderate — up to +50ms ok, but they must stay within same region for data residency. so us-west-2 only.

Infra Bot: Alert: us-west-2 GPU pool at 95% utilization; reclaim windows active 03:00-05:00 UTC.

Ella S: We could carve 8 GPUs from the internal dev pool for 48h and mark them as preemptible. That buys time for a reserved commitment or cross-region replication. Any objections? :thinking_face:

Sam T: I don't love draining dev, we've got 2 scheduled infra tests overnight that will need at least 4 GPUs. Could we do a rolling slice: 4 preemptible now + 4 from reclaimed spot during reclaim window?

Kelsey (billing): If we switch them to a 1mo reserved commit for 8 GPUs we'll get a discount vs on-demand but billing leadtime is ~24h to ingest the commit. Also watch invoice: previous customer had a weird prorate bug.

Maria G: Timeline: customer goes live 00:30 PDT. We need a concrete plan by 00:00.

Raj P: Quick checklist:
- Option A: carve 8 dev GPUs now as preemptible (no billing changes)
- Option B: submit emergency 1mo reserve (billing +24h ingest, might not help tonight)
- Option C: Move non-sensitive workloads to other regions to free up us-west-2

Ella S: I'll open a temporary allocation ticket and tag the GPUs as preemptible. Command I'll run: ```rsvp allocate --region us-west-2 --count 8 --type preemptible --ttl 48h --tag customer-X-burst```

Sam T: If we do that, add a fallback policy to auto-fallback to model-quantized variant if the burst gets preempted: routing rule name = customer-x-burst-fallback.

Maria G: Good. Also need a billing guardrail so if they exceed 80% of expected tokens we pause generation and alert sales. Kelsey can you add that throttle rule?

Kelsey (billing): Yep, I'll add a quota at the tenant level and a webhook for alerts. Note: quota enforcement only applies to hosted API, not private infra.

Infra Bot: Ticket created: #INF-4729 — temporary allocation for customer-X (8xA100 preemptible, TTL 48h). Owner: Ella S.

Tara M: Heads up for follow-up: we should start a capacity forecast for us-west-2 for next 90 days. If multiple customers scale like this we'll need at least 40% more committed capacity. I'll spin up a spreadsheet and ping finance.

Raj P: Action items agreed:
- Ella to allocate preemptible 8 GPUs now (done)
- Sam to add fallback routing and quantized model option
- Kelsey to set quota + webhook
- Maria to coordinate with customer about retry/backoff policy
- Tara to kick off 90d capacity forecast and cost estimate for 8/16/32 GPU commits

Maria G: Thanks fam. Please post when allocation completes so I can confirm with customer. :pray:

Ella S: Allocation done — resources tagged and assigned. Will monitor reclaim events and report if preemptions occur.

Infra Bot: Allocation event log: ```allocated 8 A100 (us-west-2), ids: gpu-uw2-431, gpu-uw2-432, gpu-uw2-433, gpu-uw2-434, gpu-uw2-435, gpu-uw2-436, gpu-uw2-437, gpu-uw2-438; TTL 48h; preemptible:true```

Sam T: Fallback routing deployed. Quantized variant is already warmed in cache.

Kelsey (billing): Quota + webhook created. Will monitor for anomalous spend; flagged finance to watch invoices this billing cycle.

Maria G: Confirmed with customer — they see capacity and are backfilling tests. Closing for now, will reopen if preemptions hit production. :thumbsup:
